requirement.description: The URL.__hash__ method assumes that self._val is a SplitResult object, but during unpickling it can be a tuple. This leads to AttributeError when trying to access .path attribute on a tuple.
requirement.contract: Fix the __hash__ method to properly handle both SplitResult and tuple representations of URL._val, particularly during unpickling scenarios where _val might be a tuple.

requirement.description: The URL.__setstate__ method doesn't properly handle all pickle formats. During unpickling, it receives a tuple with a dictionary in the second element, but the code tries to access attributes that don't exist on the URL object like _scheme.
requirement.contract: Update the __setstate__ method to properly handle all pickle formats, including the default style where _val is stored in a dictionary under the _val key.

requirement.description: The with_suffix method is double-encoding percent-encoded suffixes. When processing a URL with already percent-encoded path segments, the suffix processing is incorrectly re-encoding the already encoded components.
requirement.contract: Fix the with_suffix method to properly handle already encoded path segments and suffixes without double-encoding.
